label: KNOWN FACT
title: TestMigration0009 fails on a fresh checkout: schema-v6/v8 VERSION share size and mtime
what: On any checkout that writes tests/fixtures/project-update/schema-v6/.ai/VERSION and schema-v8/.ai/VERSION in the same second (fresh clone, new worktree, CI runner) git's stat cache treats the copied '8' as unchanged: 'nothing to commit', 3 errors. Reproduced in worktree release-3.0.1 (T-2026-10-29-2240 suite-1); the release workflow and tests.yml run on fresh checkouts and would go red.

why: the review report file state.py review --report reads; the worktree sandbox refuses stdin to python

findings.label: H1
findings.text: Update notice never fires on the installer's layouts (hooks/context-guard.py:753, hooks/update_notice.py:41, bin/riskrails.js:1283) in_scope: yes. Claude npx copies hooks to ~/.claude/hooks/, so plugin_root=~/.claude and ~/.claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json does not exist: installed_version None, notice always empty. Codex: codexHookFiles() is a fixed four-file list, update_notice.py is never installed, the import raises and is swallowed. Direction: installed version from <home>/riskrails/profile.json plugin_version (bin/riskrails.js:301), manifest as fallback; add update_notice.py to the Codex hook list; an installed-layout test.

findings.label: M1
findings.text: test_no_installer_directory_spawns_nothing is vacuous (tests/test_update_notice.py:112): passes with or without the isdir guard.

findings.label: M2
findings.text: A failed Release step cannot be recovered by a rerun (.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml:86-90, :42-52): verify stops at already-on-registry; a publish-only rerun fails with 403 before the release step.

findings.label: L1
findings.text: sync-version accepts prereleases and the workflow has no dist-tag (tools/sync-version.py:24, npm-publish.yml:90): v3.1.0-rc.1 ships as latest.

findings.label: L2
findings.text: The refresh child can hang and pile up (hooks/update_notice.py:101): urlopen timeout is per socket op, read unbounded, checked_at not written before the fetch.

findings.label: L4
findings.text: NODE_AUTH_TOKEN fallback unverified (npm-publish.yml:89): empty string versus unset with OIDC.

findings.label: I1
findings.text: The release gate runs the suite on a fresh checkout (npm-publish.yml:36), in_scope: no: the recorded TestMigration0009 fresh-checkout failure blocks the first tag.

findings.label: I2
findings.text: Actions pinned by tag, not SHA; pylint unpinned; a tag on any commit triggers.

findings.label: I3
findings.text: RISKRAILS_REGISTRY_URL accepts file:// and any urllib scheme; user env only, response reduced to strict X.Y.Z.

fix: detect the spawn itself (patch Popen, or a marker the file:// registry run leaves)
label: KNOWN FACT
title: test_no_installer_directory_spawns_nothing cannot fail
what: passes with or without the isdir guard in update_notice: a wrong spawn's write into the missing dir fails silently (T-2026-10-29-2240 review M1)

fix: skip the upload when the version is already there, or move the release into its own job
label: KNOWN FACT
title: Release workflow: a failed Release step cannot be rerun
what: after a successful registry upload a failed release step is stuck: a full rerun stops at already-on-registry, a publish-only rerun gets 403 (review M2)

fix: refuse prereleases in the workflow, or pass --tag next for them
label: RISK
title: A prerelease tag ships under the latest dist-tag
what: v3.1.0-rc.1 matches v*.*.* and would be published as latest, so npx riskrails@latest installs it (review L1)

fix: write checked_at before the fetch; cap read size and total time
label: RISK
title: update_notice refresh child can hang and pile up
what: urlopen timeout is per socket op, read unbounded; a hung child never writes checked_at, so each session spawns another (review L2)

label: KNOWN FACT
title: Dead skipTest in TestReleaseWorkflow
what: the skip when hooks/update_notice.py is missing can no longer trigger and would hide a deleted file (review L3)

fix: set the variable only when the secret exists, or drop the fallback once the trusted publisher is configured
label: UNKNOWN
title: Empty NODE_AUTH_TOKEN beside OIDC trusted publishing
what: with the NPM_TOKEN secret unset the env var is an empty string written into .npmrc by setup-node; untested whether npm 11 then still uses OIDC (review L4)
